title: Freight Claim Checklist
subtitle: Freight Claim Intake: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Freight Claim Checklist covers claimed shipment, affected goods, loss amount, supporting documents, mitigation, and investigation. The freight claims coordinator records Freight Claim Intake criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Freight Claim Checklist keeps Freight Claim Intake exceptions visible until the freight claims coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Freight Claim Checklist at origin, transit custody points, destination, inspection location, and evidence repository. Document claimed shipment, affected goods, loss amount, supporting documents, mitigation, and investigation identity before Freight Claim Intake begins. Compare claimed shipment, affected goods, loss amount, supporting documents, mitigation, and investigation findings with stated Freight Claim Intake criteria; route unresolved Freight Claim Intake issues to authorized claims reviewer. For Freight Claim Checklist, confirm requirements for Freight Claim Intake. Ask authorized claims reviewer to review Freight Claim Intake conditions beyond the freight claims coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspection scope and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Freight Claim Intake, identify responsible parties, origin, transit custody points, destination, inspection location, and evidence repository, and the linked claimed shipment, affected goods, loss amount, supporting documents, mitigation, and investigation source.

fields.label: Claim, bill, shipment, order, and invoice
Item, lot, serial, package, quantity, and amount

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture Freight Claim Intake facts for claimed shipment, affected goods, loss amount, supporting documents, mitigation, and investigation; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Freight Claim Intake inspection checks
items: Loss, damage, delay, or expense allegation
Mitigation, salvage, repair, and retained goods
Notice, document completeness, and investigation owner

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: List each unresolved Freight Claim Intake finding with its restriction, correction owner, and reinspection trigger. Freight Claims Coordinator records reviewer disposition.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Intake treated as liability or payment decision
Bill, invoice, packing, and delivery documents
blocks.guidance: Pause Freight Claim Intake when claim identity, determinable amount, evidence preservation, notice, or authorized investigation remains unresolved. Retain the available Freight Claim Intake proof and route unresolved claimed shipment, affected goods, loss amount, supporting documents, mitigation, and investigation scope to freight claims coordinator.
